user.title: Proxmox Host Monitor
user.description: Select the Proxmox VE node reboot button. Proxmox Host Monitor creates its own webhook for the reboot status and the disk health reports.

import_legacy.title: Import Proxmox Reboot Update
import_legacy.description: Proxmox Reboot Update is installed. Its configuration (reboot button `{reboot_button}`, webhook and update entity with its history) is taken over and Proxmox Reboot Update is removed afterwards. Existing host scripts keep working until they are replaced in the next step.

install.title: Install on the Proxmox host
install.description: The host needs two small scripts with systemd timers: one reports whether a reboot is required, one reports SMART and Btrfs disk health. Existing installations are detected and only replaced after you confirm.

menu_options.manual: Show a command to paste into the Proxmox shell

ssh.title: Install over SSH
ssh.description:
Home Assistant connects once to install the scripts. The password is used only for this connection and is **not stored**. The host key is remembered so later updates only connect to the same host.

{details}

confirm_replace.title: Existing installation found
confirm_replace.description:
The following already exists on the host:

{items}

**update** = replaced by the new version, **remove** = deleted, **disable** = timer stopped and disabled, files are kept, **keep** = left unchanged.

Submit to overwrite/update, or close this dialog to change nothing.

manual.title: Install command
manual.description:
Run this command as root in the Proxmox shell (for example Datacenter → node → Shell):

`{command}`

If something is already installed, the script lists it and asks before overwriting. Submit when it reports that Proxmox Host Monitor is installed. The first values appear within 15 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the host over SSH.
error.invalid_auth: SSH login failed. Check username and password.
error.host_key_mismatch: The host key differs from the one stored at the last installation. Make sure this is the right host.
error.install_failed: The installation on the host failed.
error.no_url: Home Assistant has no local URL the Proxmox host could reach. Set one under Settings → System → Network.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Proxmox Host Monitor is already configured. Use its options to reinstall the host scripts or change the reboot button.

state.reboot_warning: Proxmox was updated automatically. A host reboot is required. Running virtual machines and containers are shut down in an orderly manner. The host and services running on it may be unavailable for several minutes.

reboot_button_unavailable.title: Proxmox reboot button is no longer available

select_button.title: Select a Proxmox reboot button
select_button.description:
The configured reboot button `{entity_id}` does not exist or is no longer provided by its integration, so the Proxmox host cannot be rebooted from Home Assistant.

With the Proxmox VE integration, node reboot buttons are only created if the Proxmox user or API token has the `Sys.PowerMgmt` privilege on the node. Grant it, reload the Proxmox VE integration, and then select the reboot button below.

abort.entry_not_found: Proxmox Host Monitor is no longer configured.

disk_failing.title: Disk {disk} is failing
disk_failing.description:
Disk **{disk}** ({model}, serial {serial}) reports critical problems: {problems}.

The disk is not part of a Btrfs filesystem monitored by Proxmox Host Monitor. Back up its data and replace it.

disk_failing_removable.title: Disk {disk} is failing and can be removed

confirm_removal.title: Remove {disk} from {pool}?
confirm_removal.description:
Disk **{disk}** ({model}, serial {serial}) reports critical problems: {problems}.

The Proxmox host runs `btrfs device remove` for **{disk}** ({model}, serial {serial}). All data on it is moved to the other disks of `{pool}` first, which can take hours and slows down the filesystem meanwhile. The host checks again before it starts and refuses if it is no longer safe.

The host picks up the request within 5 minutes. Afterwards the disk can be disconnected.

abort.entry_not_found: Proxmox Host Monitor is no longer configured.
abort.pool_not_found: The filesystem is no longer reported by the host.

disk_failing_wait.title: Disk {disk} is failing
disk_failing_wait.description:
Disk **{disk}** ({model}, serial {serial}) reports critical problems: {problems}.

The data of `{pool}` fits on the remaining disks, but a balance is running. The disk can be removed from Home Assistant once the balance has finished.

disk_failing_no_space.title: Disk {disk} is failing: buy a new disk
disk_failing_no_space.description:
Disk **{disk}** ({model}, serial {serial}) reports critical problems: {problems}.

The remaining disks of `{pool}` cannot take over its data on their own. Add a new disk to the filesystem as soon as possible, then remove {disk}. It needs to hold at least **{needed} GB**; **{recommended} GB** are recommended so the filesystem does not shrink.

pool_space_low.title: Filesystem {pool} is running out of space
pool_space_low.description: Only **{free} GB** ({percentage} %) of `{pool}` are free. Free up space or add a disk.

removal_failed.title: Removing disk {disk} failed
removal_failed.description:
The removal of disk **{disk}** (serial {serial}) did not succeed: {reason}.

Check `journalctl -u proxmox-host-monitor-remove-{serial}` on the Proxmox host.

host_failed_unit.title: Service {item} failed on the Proxmox host
host_failed_unit.description: The systemd unit `{item}` is in the failed state. Check it with `systemctl status {item}` and `journalctl -u {item}`.

host_scrub_never.title: {item} has never been scrubbed
host_scrub_never.description: No scrub of the Btrfs filesystem `{item}` has been recorded. A scrub reads all data and repairs it from the redundant copy. Run `btrfs scrub start {item}` and schedule it monthly.

host_scrub_overdue.title: Scrub of {item} is overdue
host_scrub_overdue.description: The last scrub of `{item}` was {value} days ago. Run `btrfs scrub start {item}`.

host_scrub_uncorrectable.title: Scrub found uncorrectable errors on {item}
host_scrub_uncorrectable.description: The last scrub of `{item}` found {value} errors it could not repair. Affected files are damaged; check `btrfs scrub status {item}` and the kernel log.

host_scrub_errors.title: Scrub found errors on {item}
host_scrub_errors.description: The last scrub of `{item}` found {value} errors it does not report as repaired. Check `btrfs scrub status -R {item}` and the SMART values of the disks.

host_backup_missing.title: No backup job on the Proxmox host
host_backup_missing.description: No backup job is configured, so virtual machines and containers are not backed up. Create one under Datacenter → Backup.

host_backup_never.title: No backup has run yet
host_backup_never.description: Backup jobs exist, but no backup has run on this node yet.

host_backup_failed.title: Last backup failed
host_backup_failed.description: The last backup on the Proxmox host ended with: {value}.

host_backup_overdue.title: Last backup is {value} days old
host_backup_overdue.description: The last backup on the Proxmox host ran {value} days ago.

host_temperature.title: {item} is too hot
host_temperature.description: {item} on the Proxmox host is at {value} °C. Check cooling and fans.

host_thin_pool_full.title: Thin pool {item} is {value} % full
host_thin_pool_full.description: The LVM thin pool `{item}` is {value} % full (data or metadata). When it runs full, virtual machines on it stop. Free up space or extend the pool.

host_nic_errors.title: Network errors on {item}
host_nic_errors.description: The network interface `{item}` counted {value} receive or transmit errors since boot. Check the cable and the switch port.

host_certificate_expired.title: Proxmox certificate expired
host_certificate_expired.description: The certificate of the Proxmox web interface has expired. Renew it with `pvecm updatecerts --force` or your ACME setup.

host_certificate_expiring.title: Proxmox certificate expires in {value} days
host_certificate_expiring.description: The certificate of the Proxmox web interface expires in {value} days.

host_time_not_synchronized.title: Proxmox host clock is not synchronized
host_time_not_synchronized.description: The system clock of the Proxmox host is not synchronized with a time server. Check `timedatectl` and chrony.

host_unattended_upgrades_failed.title: Automatic updates failed
host_unattended_upgrades_failed.description: The last run of unattended-upgrades on the Proxmox host failed. Check `/var/log/unattended-upgrades/`.

confirm_rollback.title: Roll {guest} back to {snapshot}?

abort.guest_not_found: The container is no longer reported by the host.
abort.guest_update_running: An update or rollback of the container is already running.

guest_update_failed_no_snapshot.title: Update of container {guest} failed
guest_update_failed_no_snapshot.description:
The update of container **{guest}** (CT {vmid}) failed before anything was changed: {error}

The full log is in `/var/log/proxmox-host-monitor/guest-{vmid}.log` on the Proxmox host.

guest_unavailable.message: Container {guest} is not running or was not reported by the Proxmox host recently.

guest_update_running.message: An update or rollback of container {guest} is already running.
